text:
nina_csm: Thessaly Labs requested a short-term EU egress allowlist + QPS bump for a customer-facing demo tomorrow. They said demo reliability will factor into renewal discussions. @leo_netops can we do this quickly?

leo_netops: Need the exact IPs + demo window and expected sustained/peak QPS. Also prefer narrower CIDRs if possible.

nina_csm: They gave these: 
``
192.0.2.88/32
198.51.101.16/28
```
Window: 2026-03-27 10:00-14:00 UTC. Desired baseline: 200 QPS, allow bursts to 400. They want auto-revoke after the window.

leo_netops: 198.51.101.16/28 is OK but please confirm there won't be arbitrary additional IPs. I'll need a ticket and an owner for rollback. We'll add capacity alerts and a fallback routing plan to gcp-eu if eu-edge gets saturated.

sam_support: Ticket INF-4620 created and assigned to @leo_netops: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4620. Details and windows attached.

mara_prod: Recommended rollout: 1) create eu-edge allowlist rule scoped to the specified prefixes; 2) set qps=200 and burst=400; 3) enable prefix-level caching and kv-cache warm for that customer; 4) monitor 1m and 5m latency aggregates + 5xx rate; 5) auto-revoke 14:15 UTC (15m buffer). If p50 latency >150ms or error rate >1% for >5m, rollback to baseline and notify CSM.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: allowlist rule created: rule-9654, scope=eu-edge, auto_revoke=2026-03-27T14:15:00Z, ticket=INF-4620 :white_check_mark:

nina_csm: Noted. I'll ask Thessaly to lock down the CIDR to those two entries only. Also flagged as renewal risk in Gainsight  if the demo performs poorly they said they'd accelerate Dedicated discussions.

leo_netops: Applying QPS change now (qps=200, burst=400). Setting capacity alert at 80% and paging eng-oncall on breach. Adding a temporary rate-limit fallback to the us-eu-fallback pool if saturating. Documenting the rollback owner and steps in INF-4620.

sam_support: Calendared the demo with reminders and post-demo feedback slot. Will capture traces and console metrics, and attach to INF-4620 for postmortem.

nina_csm: Thanks team. I'll confirm with the customer and collect post-demo notes for renewal conversation. Please keep logs in the ticket. :thumbsup:
